description: AgentProp-Bench revision, workstream A (propagation statistics). All numbers computed from data/results/*.csv by scripts/A_*.py.

data_files.p2: data/results/p2_all_rejudged.csv (contains all 13 models; the four open-weight p2_*_rejudged.csv files are identical subsets, verified cell-by-cell)
data_files.baseline: data/results/baseline_all_rejudged.csv (same; open-weight baseline files are identical subsets)

get_patient_record.injected_call_error_behaviour: error only if ID outside P001-P005

get_events.injected_call_error_behaviour: never returns an error dict (mock events generated)

get_historical.injection: city -> alternative city (city checked before dates)
get_historical.injected_call_error_behaviour: no error unless the model's own dates are malformed/reversed

delete_event.injected_call_error_behaviour: returns error 'not found' -- but so does the un-injected id, store is empty

paired_risk_difference.pairing_rule: 1:1 on (task_id, model); exactly one baseline run per (task_id, model) exists
